description: Generate a document from a saved template and invite each Signer role, with optional CopyReceiver roles, by signer ID or full name and email. Editor roles use only editor_fields. Find roles with assinafy_list_templates and validate editor_fields values with assinafy_validate_fields first. DigitalCertificate signers require a template without placed signer fields. This sends invitations and can consume credits.

account_id.description: account ID; uses request routing if omitted

value.description: value to bake into the generated document

estimate_only.description: preview cost and balances for the given roles without creating contacts, documents or invitations; roles alone are sufficient

expires_at.description: assignment expiry as an ISO 8601 date or date-time

max_total_credits.description: maximum credits allowed for sending; use total_credits from the latest estimate

signers.description: one entry per Signer role and optional CopyReceiver roles; Editor roles use editor_fields

email.description: signer's email address, required when id is omitted; existing exact matches are reused

full_name.description: signer's full name; required when id is omitted

id.description: existing signer ID; use instead of full_name and email

notification_methods.description: at most one channel: Email or Whatsapp; inferred from verification_method when omitted

step.description: signing order, contiguous from 1; all Signer roles must set it if any does; CopyReceiver roles ignore it

verification_method.description: Email (default), Whatsapp, DigitalCertificate (A1/A3, templates without placed signer fields only), or IdDocumentFaceMatchBasic (the signer completes ID photo and liveness checks on Assinafy's signing page; this tool never receives those images or face data)

tags.description: tag names, merged with the template's defaults

name: assinafy_create_document_from_template
title: Send a template for signature
